summary: Bold Eagle Acquisition Corp., a Nasdaq-listed blank-check company, filed an 8-K on October 20, 2026, disclosing a joint press release with REDL Intermediate Holdings, LLC (REDLattice) announcing the confidential submission of a draft Form S-4 registration statement for their previously announced business combination. No price, stake, premium, or closing date is stated in the excerpt. The S-4 will include a preliminary proxy statement/prospectus; after effectiveness, a shareholder vote record date will be set. Structural overhang centers on SPAC redemption risk and the regulatory review clock; watch for public S-4 filing, redemptions, and PIPE terms as the de-SPAC arbitrage angle.
